summary: This analysis reviews four closed trades on Adobe (ADBE) executed as part of an autonomous thesis challenge. All four trades occurred on 2026-04-30. Two trades had exit prices of 247.3 and 258.36, while the other two experienced significant losses, with exit prices also at 247.3 and 258.36. The two losing trades incurred substantial negative P&L, with a -52.07% and -49.93% P&L percentage respectively.
thesis: The autonomous trading strategy applied to Adobe (ADBE) resulted in two profitable trades and two significant losses on 2026-04-30, indicating a potential mismatch between the strategy and market conditions or a flaw in the trade execution logic.

The entry prices of 516.0 were significantly higher than the exit prices, contributing to the substantial losses in two trades.
The P&L percentages of -52.07% and -49.93% represent a considerable negative impact on the overall portfolio performance.
limitations: The analysis is limited to the provided trade data and does not consider external market factors.
